set.body:
Scope: SurfaceAtlas, standard surface routes, GIFTI atlas loaders and atlas spatial graph adapters; neuroatlas4s optional surface/routing modules.

Deliverable: Use neurosurf4s support and shared world declarations for atlas assignments and routes. Keep atlas catalog/template asset policy here, while surface registration/projection mechanics remain in neurosurf4s/providers.

Acceptance:
- Surface atlas query/reduction and relevant volume/surface atlas routes preserve vertex/parcel identity, hierarchy and exact ordering on JVM/JS.
- Route confidence, exact versus approximate mapping, source evidence and template versus sampling identity remain explicit.
- No atlas dependency flows back into neuroim4s/neurosurf4s; core catalog and surface-only use avoid rendering and unnecessary volume dependencies.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: A1: Move surface atlas realizations and atlas-specific routes
